title: plan-review finding
description: One adversarial-review finding against an implementation plan. Emitted as one JSON object per line in <lens>.findings.jsonl during Phase 2; verdict is populated by the orchestrator after Phase 3, and cluster_id/canonical/severity are finalised by the orchestrator in Phase 4.

id.description: Stable per-run finding ID, e.g. 'baseline-diff-auditor-003'. Prefix with the lens name, zero-padded index suffix.

severity.description: blocking = the plan cannot be implemented as written, or shipping it breaks something live. contract-gap = a requirement is stated but no step defines the mechanism, or a baseline item was dropped with no recorded decision. minor = stale reference, wrong status line, base-branch drift with no conflict. judgment-call = an intentional-looking omission the review cannot adjudicate; must be framed as a question naming two defensible answers and what each costs.

confidence.description: How directly the evidence proves the claim - high = the cited path:line or command output alone proves it; medium = evidence plus one inference step; low = inferred from indirect signals such as omission or structure.

anchor.description: Where in the PLAN (or its sidecar) the problem lives. The plan's own words are evidence of intent, never of fact - see `evidence` for the repository side.

document.description: Repo-relative path of the plan document, decisions sidecar, or testing doc the quote is drawn from.

heading.description: The heading (or 'preamble') the quote falls under.

step_id.description: Inventory step/requirement/AC id this finding attaches to, e.g. 'S-04', 'R-11', 'AC-03'.

quote.description: Exact quoted phrase from the document. A finding with no anchor is not a finding - do not paraphrase the document into a quote.

evidence.description: The repository-side ground truth. A finding whose evidence cannot be produced as a path:line reference or a runnable command is dropped, not softened.

kind.description: path-line = a repo-relative `path:line` (or `path:startLine-endLine`) that can be opened. command = a runnable command whose output demonstrates the claim.

ref.description: The `path:line` reference, or the exact runnable command including arguments (e.g. `git ls-tree origin/main -- steps/`).

observed.description: What that reference or command actually shows, quoted or summarised faithfully. Not what the plan claims it shows.

refs.description: Phase 1 inventory IDs this finding relates to: S=Steps, R=Requirements, AC=Acceptance criteria, X=Cross-references, B=Baseline items, E=Ground-truth facts.

baseline_ref.description: Baseline inventory id (B-nn) plus its section number, for baseline-diff-auditor findings.

disposition.description: baseline-diff-auditor only. How the plan treats this baseline item. A 'dropped' entry the plan neither implements nor lists as a non-goal with a reason is always a finding.

consequence.description: The concrete downstream failure if unaddressed - not 'this is unclear' but what actually breaks, for whom, when.

suggested_fix.description: Optional. The specific question the plan owner needs to answer. This skill is a gate, not implementation - do not propose fixes unless asked.

cluster_id.description: Populated by the orchestrator in Phase 4 when near-duplicate findings across lenses are merged. All members of a cluster share one id.

canonical.description: Populated by the orchestrator in Phase 4. True for the one finding in a cluster whose statement reaches the report.

verdict.description: Populated by the orchestrator after Phase 3 ground-truth verification. Absent on the lens's initial emission.

reasoning.description: The verifier's reasoning, kept for the report's 'Considered and dropped' appendix when refuted.

lenses_used.description: deep mode only - which of the three verifier lenses were run.

votes.description: Number of verifiers voting 'survived', out of votes_total. Only present at depth deep (3-verifier majority).
